title: HTC VIVE Tracker 3.0: Full Body Motion Tracking Sensor for VR (SteamVR Compatible)
body_html:
VIVE Tracker 3.0

  • Product type: VR full-body tracking device
  • Tracking: SteamVR™ Lighthouse
  • Requirements: Base Station 2.0 or Base Station 1.0
  • Battery Life: Up to 7.5 hours
  • Weight: 75g
  • Compatibility: VIVE, SteamVR™ Headsets
  • Use Cases: Full-body tracking, motion capture
  • Mounting: 1/4" standard camera mount

Track movement and bring objects from the real world into the virtual universe.

Create a seamless connection between real objects and the virtual experience. Capture full-body movement with pinpoint accuracy. Integrate external devices with ease. Take your VR to a new level with the VIVE Tracker (3.0).

VIVE Tracker 3.0 uses SteamVR™ Lighthouse infrared laser tracking for sub-millimeter positional accuracy and does not rely on cameras. Its sensors detect infrared laser sweeps emitted by SteamVR Base Stations, and SteamVR computes position and orientation in six degrees of freedom (6DoF). It can be used in headset-based or headset-free setups where precise tracking data is required, including motion capture, robotics, simulation, and custom tracking applications built on SteamVR and Lighthouse tracking.

Specs

Tracking: SteamVR™ Lighthouse tracking (requires SteamVR™ Base Stations BS1.0 or BS2.0)

Tracking Type: External infrared laser-based tracking (no cameras / not inside-out)

Weight: 75g

Dimensions: 70.9 × 79.0 × 44.1 mm

Battery Life: Up to 7.5 hours

Field of view: 240°

In the box

  • VIVE Tracker (3.0)
  • Wireless dongle
  • Dongle cradle (USB-C)
  • USB-C cable

Tracker mounting accessories (including track straps) are sold separately.

*Tracker compatibility may vary. Please check your product information prior to use.
Requires SteamVR™ Base Stations and compatible SteamVR software (sold separately).
Requires available USB ports on your PC for wireless dongles. Number of VIVE Trackers in use simultaneously may be limited by free USB connectors, application support, and RF conditions.

Compatibility: VIVE Tracker 3.0 works within SteamVR tracking ecosystems that support Lighthouse tracking. It can be used with compatible headsets or in standalone (headset-free) tracking setups for motion capture, robotics, simulation, and custom applications.

**All battery claim results will vary. Battery life and charge cycles vary by use.
